title: Facebook Posts Pro input
description: Scrape posts from public Facebook pages and profiles, or single posts, videos and reels.

startUrls.title: Facebook URLs
startUrls.description: Public pages and profiles (facebook.com/name, profile.php?id=…, /people/…), or single posts, photos, videos, reels and share links. Pages return their latest posts; post/video URLs return that one post.

resultsLimit.title: Max posts per page
resultsLimit.description: How many posts to save from each page or profile (newest first). Filtered-out posts do not count.

onlyPostsNewerThan.title: Only posts newer than
onlyPostsNewerThan.description: A date (2025-01-31), a date-time, or a period ("7 days", "3 months"). Paging stops once posts get older than this — so it also saves time and money.

onlyPostsOlderThan.title: Only posts older than
onlyPostsOlderThan.description: A date or a period ("2 days"). Use together with "newer than" for a date window.

postTypes.title: Post types
postTypes.description: Keep only these kinds of posts. Empty = all types.

keywords.title: Only posts mentioning
keywords.description: Keep posts whose text, link title or shared post contains any of these words or phrases (whole words, any case). Matches are listed in "matchedKeywords".

minReactions.title: Min reactions
minReactions.description: Skip posts with fewer reactions. 0 = off.

minComments.title: Min comments
minComments.description: Skip posts with fewer comments. 0 = off.

topCommentsPerPost.title: Top comments per post
topCommentsPerPost.description: Top comments Facebook shows with each post (text, author, time, likes) — included at no extra cost. 0 = leave out.

fetchVideoDetails.title: Video details (views, title, duration, video URL)
fetchVideoDetails.description: For video and reel posts, open the video page once to add views, title, duration and the video file URL.

includeVideoTranscript.title: Video transcripts
includeVideoTranscript.description: Add the spoken text of video posts: from the creator's captions when available, otherwise by AI if you add your own key below. Charged per transcript.

aiProvider.title: AI transcription for videos without captions
aiProvider.description: Used only with "Video transcripts". You pay the AI provider directly (Groq ≈ $0.04 / audio hour, OpenAI ≈ $0.36 / audio hour).

aiApiKey.title: AI provider API key
aiApiKey.description: Your Groq or OpenAI API key. Stored encrypted by Apify and only sent to the provider you chose.

aiMaxMinutes.title: Max video length for AI (minutes)
aiMaxMinutes.description: Longer videos without captions are not sent to AI. Video files above 25 MB are skipped too.

maxResults.title: Max posts in total
maxResults.description: Stop after this many saved (and charged) posts across all pages. 0 = no limit.

includeFailedInputs.title: Show inputs without posts
includeFailedInputs.description: Adds a free row (status = not_found / no_timeline / blocked / invalid_input / no_posts …) with the reason and how to fix it.

skipPreviouslyScraped.title: Skip posts saved in previous runs
skipPreviouslyScraped.description: Remembers saved post IDs in a named key-value store — ideal for scheduled page monitoring.

dedupeStoreName.title: Memory store name
dedupeStoreName.description: Key-value store used by "Skip posts saved in previous runs". Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.

proxyFallback.title: Automatic proxy fallback
proxyFallback.description: If Facebook keeps sending the chosen proxy to its login page, switch automatically to Apify residential, then datacenter proxy, then the server IP.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Facebook sends datacenter IPs to its login page and rate-limits them. Residential works best.
